description: Registry machine-readable produksi invariants myc. Setiap invariant punya ID stabil; status = enforced | partial | target. Detail implementasi di docs/production-invariants.md.

invariants.title: Bug evidence dominates incompleteness
invariants.notes: has_findings evaluated before has_incomplete; BUG + INCOMPLETE stays violation

invariants.title: Heuristics cannot create hard safety verdicts
Identical verification identity -> identical receipt identity
invariants.notes: myc_build_receipt; golden portable = determinisme dua-run (fingerprint mesin-spesifik)

invariants.title: Different semantic environment must not reuse stale evidence
Child output cannot spoof semantic evidence
invariants.notes: MYC-AUDIT-017: evidence utama = sanitizer report log_path; marker+exit0 diabaikan

invariants.title: Source is never interpreted as a shell command
invariants.notes: program+argv[] eksplisit; CreateProcess / fork+execvp tanpa shell

invariants.title: Timeout is terminal for that process tree
invariants.notes: POSIX setpgid+kill(-pid)+eskalasi; Windows Job Object; drain join (AUDIT-001/002)

invariants.title: Receipt binds evidence to source
invariants.notes: receipt memuat source_sha256; replay hanya bila key cocok

invariants.title: Unknown enum/state fails closed
invariants.notes: reducer fails closed (PR-003 default -> has_incomplete + debt); cache_entry_semantic_ok (PR-013) menolak verdict out-of-range sebelum parse — NEVER clamp ke MC_OK

invariants.title: Partial write is never valid cache
invariants.notes: read side fail-closed (miss+recompute); write atomik myc_persist_atomic_write (PR-012 / P3-T03); sidecar sha256 (PR-013)

invariants.title: Backend identity is evidence
invariants.notes: gcc_version/clang_version exact tool identity (MYC-AUDIT-022); tool_key cache

invariants.title: Reproduction command is semantically complete
invariants.notes: verify: command penuh + witness repro + capsule

invariants.title: Production mode never silently weakens requested assurance
invariants.notes: budget contract + --production (require_complete + min_version floor P5-T03); FINDINGS not overwritten
